Next month predictions based on historical data

View predicted fuel costs and efficiency for next month based on your historical refill data. These predictions use Holt\'s Linear Exponential Smoothing algorithm to analyze trends in your fuel consumption patterns.
Based on %1$d months of historical data, here are the predicted values for next month:
This is how much you\'ll spend on fuel per kilometer driven next month. A lower value means better fuel economy. The algorithm analyzes your refill patterns to predict this cost.

This is your predicted fuel consumption in liters per 100 kilometers. Lower values indicate more efficient fuel usage. This prediction helps you spot changes in your driving habits or vehicle performance.
Not enough historical data for reliable forecast
Predict future fuel costs and efficiency using historical trends
Fuel forecasting is currently disabled.\n\nEnable it in Settings → Data & Storage → Forecast & Predictions
No forecast data available.\n\nAdd at least 3 months of fuel refills to see predictions.

📊 Understanding Confidence Scores:

The confidence percentage shows how reliable each prediction is. It's calculated based on:
• Amount of historical data (more months = higher confidence)
• Consistency of your refill patterns
• Historical prediction accuracy

🟢 70-100%% = Excellent reliability
🟠 40-69%% = Good reliability
🔴 Below 40%% = Limited reliability (need more data)

Confidence: %1$d%% - This shows how reliable the prediction is. Higher percentages mean more accurate predictions based on consistent historical data. With %2$d months of data, the forecast reliability is %3$s.
🔺 Increasing - Your costs are trending upward. This may be due to rising fuel prices, longer trips, or decreased efficiency. Monitor your driving habits and vehicle maintenance.
🔻 Decreasing - Your costs are trending downward. Great job! This indicates improving fuel efficiency, better driving habits, or lower fuel prices.
➡️ Stable - Your costs remain consistent. Your fuel consumption patterns are predictable and stable month-to-month.

💡 How to improve:
• Maintain steady speed and avoid rapid acceleration
• Keep tires properly inflated
• Regular vehicle maintenance
• Plan routes to minimize distance
• Remove unnecessary weight from vehicle
